policy: Every critical/high npm-audit finding must be fixed OR listed here with owner + mitigation + non-expired expiry (R6-03 #281). Dev/build exposure is NOT equated to packaged-runtime exposure — the desktop app's production dependencies (react, react-dom, ws, electron-updater, @xterm/*, prosemirror/*, zustand, etc.) contain NONE of these advisories. The gate (scripts/check-deps-audit.mjs) fails on unowned critical/high or invalid/expired exceptions.

exceptions.exposure: dev (test runner; not in packaged runtime)
exceptions.mitigation: Upgrade vitest to ^5.0.3 (major, pulls fixed tinypool/@vitest/mocker/vite-node) in a dedicated PR with full test regression. Exploitability nil: dev-only, runs trusted project tests.

exceptions.exposure: dev (transitive of vitest; not in packaged runtime)
exceptions.mitigation: Resolved by the vitest ^5.0.3 upgrade (this is a vitest transitive). Dev-only test pool.

exceptions.exposure: dev (electron:dev script only; not in packaged runtime)
exceptions.mitigation: The npm-suggested fix (downgrade to 9.2.1) is contradictory — installed is ^10.0.5, and the advisory range is >=9.2.3. Replace or upgrade concurrently after resolving the audit-metadata inconsistency; do NOT blindly downgrade. Dev-only, runs trusted local dev commands.

exceptions.exposure: dev (transitive of concurrently, electron:dev; not in packaged runtime)
exceptions.mitigation: Resolved by the concurrently replacement/upgrade. Dev-only command-quoting.
